what: A drone synth in the spirit of 80s sci-fi film scores: colossal brass, endless reverb, rain on neon. 7 presets, four macro knobs on sweetspots, DRONE, EPIC, a low split the melody follows, GLIDE, key pressure, CUES, MEMORY, and a film on the screen: eight night-city scenes that light up with your notes and sound like a city.
author: swtdr34mz
